intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for R2dbcAuditTrail. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing AuditTrail with the non-blocking Spring DatabaseClient: inserts one row into append-only table audit_trail (columns actor, action = enum name, outcome, occurred_at = UTC LocalDateTime of the entry timestamp, correlation_id; id is database-generated). Never updates or deletes. Failures surface as error signals. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration (no stereotype annotation). REAL-SUBSTRATE RUN REQUIRED: the test boots the embedded H2 substitute through r2dbc-h2 with URL option NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE, executes the ACTUAL queued V1 and V2 Flyway migration scripts found in the project's db/migrations folder (stage-0 database step) read from the project filesystem (never retyped DDL) and asserts the durable rows read back, covering valid inserts AND constraint-violating cases. A mocked DatabaseClient case may exist only as an extra shape check beside it. Assert the stored row fields equal the entry and that rows accumulate (append-only).
